t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Tim precision is more important than trying to figure out a strategy.  Go with the flow and answer quickly.

vb_textbox.text: It's not worth trying to figure out a pattern with the gnomes' hat shapes, colours or anything else.  Treat the gnome selection like you would the toss of a coin and let your main focus be on hitting the space bar in a timely manner once you are in the forest.  Best of luck :)
